description: Cost broken down by billing component for a deployment: cost_type (datahot, datacontent, general-purpose-search, retained_gcp, support, inference, transfer, snapshot, ...), cost_category (data_tier, platform, transfer, snapshot, other), and whether the component is allocatable to a data stream. Use this to explain WHERE a deployment's money goes and how much of it can be attributed to workloads at all.

configuration.query:
FROM billing_cluster_cost_lookup
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_conf_lookup ON @timestamp >= conf_start_date AND @timestamp <= conf_end_date
| WHERE DATE_DIFF("day", @timestamp, NOW()) <= ?days AND deployment_id == ?deployment_id
| EVAL cost = total_chargeable_units * conf_chargeable_unit_rate
| STATS cost = SUM(cost) BY cost_type, cost_category, is_allocatable
| SORT cost DESC
| LIMIT 50

deployment_id.description: Deployment ID or Serverless project ID
